thread:
kevin.h (oncall): Pager fired - p99 latency spike on /v1/chat/completions routes across multiple models 5m ago. Seeing ~2.3s p99 for `mistral-8x` and 1.6s p99 for `rwkv-2` on eu-west. Customers reported UI slowdowns. @maya can you pick this up? :pager:
maya (oncall): On it. I can confirm the alert noise — it's hitting p99 threshold across many routes but p95 mostly ok. Opening live triage. Incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED 1735604821 - Chat latency p99 surge.

incident-bot: Pager duty run initiated. Notified: kevin.h, maya. Suggested mitigations: route-squelch, fallback to smaller model, disable batching for affected pool.

maya (oncall): Quick notes from logs: many requests have long KV cache misses and a backlog on gpu-pool-9. Example log snippet: ```
2025-06-04T12:20:13Z WARN request=abc123 model=mistral-8x worker=gpu-9 queue_ms=820 cache_miss=true
2025-06-04T12:20:14Z ERROR request=abc456 model=rwkv-2 worker=gpu-9 exec_ms=1500
```

liam.sre: I'm seeing a scheduling spike on gpu-9 due to a rolling recompile job that should've been throttled. I just squashed that job. If queue clears we'll see p99 drop.

kevin.h (oncall): Good call. Meanwhile support noted two paying customers saw ~5x latency in UI. @juniper any customer-facing notes?

juniper.support: Chatted with acct team — two customers (acme-corp, medai) flagged slow text completions affecting chat. They've been told we're investigating. Will escalate to account managers if impact persists >30m.

maya (oncall): Mitigation plan in chat: 1) Short-term: apply route squelch for noisy models on `/v1/chat/completions` to reduce pagers, 2) spin up extra small gpu pool and route lower-confidence traffic to it, 3) temporary p99 alert mute for models while we validate baseline. Need approval to change p99 thresholds by model. :eyes:

sara.platform: For (1) we can add a per-route squelch with 5m decay. I'll patch routing policy in prod: add rule `squelch: {route: "/v1/chat/completions", models: ["mistral-8x"], window: "5m"}`. For (2) provisioning + warmup ~8min. For (3) we shouldn't mute global p99 — propose instead adjust thresholds per-model for the next 30m: mistral-8x p99 -> 2.5s (from 1.2s), rwkv-2 p99 -> 1.8s (from 1.0s). Record change and auto-revert.

kevin.h (oncall): I prefer adjust-with-auto-revert rather than full mute. Document exact alert queries so audit is clean. Use an annotation that includes "post-incident-audit: true".

maya (oncall): Adding the alert query we currently use:
```yaml
alert: ChatRouteP99High
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/chat.*",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le, model)) > 1.2
for: 5m
```
Proposed per-model patches: change `> 1.2` to model-specific thresholds via label filters. Example for mistral-8x:
```yaml
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/chat.*",model="mistral-8x",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le)) > 2.5
```

liam.sre: I'll push the alert-update as a scoped override in the alerts repo and add an automatic revert PR that triggers in 30m. I'll also add a temporary dashboard panel that shows p95/p99 per-model to track regressions. Link: <https://redwood.internal/dashboards/chat-latency?panel=models-p99> :link:

sara.platform: I've applied the routing squelch. Logs show reduced queue length on gpu-9. Provisioning extra pool now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by sara.platform - route-squelch-policy v1.2 -> prod
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded in 30s. :white_check_mark:

maya (oncall): After squelch and blocking the recompile job, p99 for mistral-8x dropped from 2.3s -> 1.9s in 5m. Not fully back to baseline but better. Spinning up pool ETA 7m.

kevin.h (oncall): Good. Liam, proceed with alert-adjust PRs. Make sure to add runbook note: "if p99 model-specific spikes persist after squelch + pool scale, failover to fallback-model v1 (smaller) and notify support)."

liam.sre: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/789 - contains per-model thresholds and auto-revert timer. Added the following annotation to each alert: `mitigation-notes: "squelch+scale applied; auto-revert 30m"`.

juniper.support: FYI customers updated. Both acme-corp and medai are monitoring. Acme wants a follow-up postmortem email.

maya (oncall): Quick check-in 12m after initial: p99 mistral-8x = 1.07s, p99 rwkv-2 = 0.98s, global p95 stable. Looks like mitigations healed the worst of it. I'm demoting the pager to low noise for now. :thumbsup:

kevin.h (oncall): Thanks. Next steps: 1) keep per-model p99 adjustments active until auto-revert (30m) 2) liam to file post-incident item for compile job throttling 3) platform to add a dedicated p99-per-model dashboard to prod observability 4) support to draft customer note. I'll own the postmortem.

liam.sre: Filed ticket INF-3217: "recompile job should honor cluster throttles; caused gpu-9 backlog". Assigning to infra-team.

sara.platform: I'll schedule the dashboard work — proposing two panels: p95/p99 by model and queue depth by worker pool. Will include an option to filter by route and region.

maya (oncall): Closing the live triage here. If anyone sees a regression re-open thread. Thanks team. :clap:
